plainTranslation: Their movement toward unfamiliar growth presses against how you present yourself and enter situations, making differences between their direction and your usual approach harder to ignore.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
summaryShort: Their movement toward unfamiliar growth presses against how you present yourself and enter situations, making differences between their direction and your usual approach harder to ignore.
summaryDeep: Their movement toward unfamiliar growth presses against how you present yourself and enter situations, making differences between their direction and your usual approach harder to ignore. You may feel pushed to adjust before it feels natural because the direction they are developing does not fit your usual way of showing up. The pressure can clarify a choice, but it is not a fate claim and does not require you to follow their direction.
